decisions.title: Human merge authority
decisions.context: Multi-agent coding can produce green tests via unsafe paths.
decisions.decision: Agents must not merge or ship; humans retain final merge authority after diff review.
decisions.consequences: Overnight agents stop at PR-ready evidence packs.
decisions.author: human

decisions.title: Test Designer isolation
decisions.context: Collusion weakens oracles when the same context writes tests and code.
decisions.decision: Test Designer must not share a writable worktree with Implementer; use CAID worktree+fresh-pi isolation.
decisions.consequences: Slightly higher setup cost; stronger process determinism.
decisions.author: human
